title: Configure India FY 2026-27 Income Tax Slabs, Statutory Ceilings & Leave LWP Policy
statement: As a Payroll Admin, I want to maintain India FY 2026-27 New (u/s 115BAC) and Old tax slabs, EPF/ESIC ceilings, State PT slabs, and Leave Type LWP mappings inside OXD Payroll Configuration.

title: Create India Monthly INR Pay Period with Overlap Prevention
statement: As a Payroll Admin, I want to create India monthly INR pay periods while blocking overlapping calendar date ranges.

title: Manage Employee India Statutory Profile & Masked Banking Inside PIM
statement: As a Payroll Admin, I want to maintain employee PAN, UAN, ESIC, PT state, Tax Regime, Chapter VI-A declarations, and masked bank accounts inside PIM left navigation.

title: Freeze Immutable Per-Run PIM Snapshots & Triage Ineligible Staff
statement: As a Payroll Admin, I want batch calculation to snapshot each employee's eligibility and INR salary with idempotent run creation and clear skip codes.

title: Compute Approved Unpaid Leave (LWP) Using Configured Divisor Modes
statement: As a Payroll Engine, I compute LWP deductions from Leave using explicit ohrm_payroll_leave_policy and configured CALENDAR_DAYS, WORKING_DAYS, or FIXED_30 divisor modes.

title: Compute Attendance / Timesheet Hours & Overtime Without Double-Counting
statement: As a Payroll Engine, I ingest Attendance or Timesheet hours from one primary configured mode and enforce the overtime_eligible_max_basic salary ceiling.

title: Calculate India Statutory EPF/EPS, ESIC, State PT & FY 2026-27 TDS
statement: As a Payroll Engine, I compute INR EPF/EPS, ESIC <= 21k, State PT (incl. MH Feb 300), FY 2026-27 115BAC/Old TDS, Sec 87A 12L rebate, Sec 288B rounding, and 4% cess.

title: Reserve Approved INR Expense Claims During Calculation Without Double Payout
statement: As a Payroll Engine, I reserve APPROVED INR claims into ohrm_payroll_claim_link with unique active_claim_lock and exclude them from ESIC/TDS wage bases.

title: Apply Audited Manual Overrides Strictly Before Run Submission
statement: As a Payroll Admin, I want audited INR overrides permitted in CALCULATED/REJECTED states and blocked once submitted or locked.

title: Enforce Maker-Checker Separation of Duties & Run Locking
statement: As a PayrollApprover (Checker), I enforce SoD blocking creator self-approval (403), process Reject/Resubmit/Approve cycles, and Lock to publish ESS payslips.

title: Export NEFT Bank CSV & Settle Linked Claims on Bank UTR Reconciliation
statement: As a PayrollApprover, I enforce Bank/IFSC completeness (422 guard) before NEFT CSV export and settle run & linked Claims to PAID upon UTR confirmation.

title: ESS & PIM Self-Service INR Payslip Preview & Strict BOLA/IDOR Isolation
statement: As an Employee (ESS), I can preview and download my PUBLISHED INR HTML payslip while cross-employee slip/endpoint access returns HTTP 403.
